## Popover

An anchored floating surface that hosts a focused interaction next to a source element — it **raises** a focused something out of the source's small footprint without taking the user away from the source. A standalone, remixable extraction of the `boxel-surface` `Lift` primitive whose only npm dependency is `@floating-ui/dom` (shimmed as a global virtual module in every realm).

### Orthogonal axes
Each dial does exactly one thing and reads only its own value, so any combination is predictable:
- **kind** — `details` · `edit` · `tools` — ARIA role + autofocus default + CSS theme
- **anchoring** — `beside` · `overlay` · `center` — position only
- **size** — `compact` · `comfortable` · `spacious` · `auto` — min/max width + height
- **backdrop** — `none` · `tint` · `blur` · `dim` — surface material
- **elevation** — `flat` · `raised` · `elevated` · `floating` — shadow depth + radius

### Keyboard / focus (explicit opt-ins)
- **@keyboardModel** — `'pick'` (focus a `[role=listbox]`, route arrow keys) or `'edit'` (focus the editor input, route typing keys). Omit to leave key handling to the host.
- **@trapFocus** — trap Tab inside the popover (aria-modal). Use for editor popovers that own the full focus cycle.

### Escalation
Pass `@canEscalateTo` (kinds other than the current `@kind`) plus `@onEscalate` to render a compact corner glyph (✎ → edit, ⓘ → details, ⋯ → tools / multiple targets). The toolbar is OFF by default; single-kind contracts get no chrome.

### Per-kind content via named blocks
The host supplies one named block per kind — `<:details>`, `<:edit>`, `<:tools>` — and the popover renders the block matching the current `@kind`. No host-side `{{#if (eq kind …)}}` dispatch: changing `@kind` (including via escalation) swaps the rendered block live while the popover stays open. Supply a block for every kind reachable through `@kind` or `@canEscalateTo` (a missing block renders an empty pane); a single-kind popover writes just one block. Each block's content is wrapped in `.bx-popover__pane` with `data-bx-popover-pane='<kind>'` — a styling hook with **no padding** (the body's picker convention applies: each editor pane owns its own gutter).

### Calling convention
The host owns **what** (open/close state, kind state, body content); the Popover owns **how** (positioning, dismissal on Esc / outside-click, focus enter/restore, per-kind chrome, the optional dim overlay).

## Usage

The **Popover Playground** example is the canonical reference — every axis is a live control there, and it prints the exact invocation as you change dials. The minimal shape:

```gts
import Popover from '../popover.gts';

<template>
  <button data-anchor='preview'>Open</button>

  <Popover
    @anchor='[data-anchor=preview]'
    @open={{this.open}}
    @kind='details'
    @anchoring='beside'
    @placement='bottom'
    @offset={{8}}
    @size='comfortable'
    @backdrop='none'
    @elevation='raised'
    @onDismiss={{this.close}}
  >
    <:details>
      …details content…
    </:details>
  </Popover>
</template>
```

- `@anchor` is a CSS selector string the popover positions against.
- `@open` + `@onDismiss` — the host owns open/close state; the popover calls `@onDismiss` on Esc / outside-click.
- `@placement` / `@offset` / `@arrow` apply only when `@anchoring='beside'`.
- For an editor popover, add `@kind='edit'`, `@keyboardModel='edit'`, and `@trapFocus={{true}}`.
- For hover-to-open / click-to-escalate wiring across many source units, drive it through `PopoverState` + the `surfacePopoverBinding` modifier rather than managing `@open` by hand.

## Theming & customization

The popover follows the theme of the card that anchors it. Theme CSS variables are scoped to the themed card's container while the popover portals to `document.body`, so on open the popover adopts the anchor's theme scope (or, with no scope, copies the **resolved** tokens from the anchor) — dark mode and Brand Guide custom variables included.

Every visual value resolves through three scopes, strongest first:

1. **Popover-only knobs** — `--bx-popover-*` custom properties. Set these in a Brand Guide's *Custom CSS Variables* to restyle ONLY the popover; nothing else on the card is affected. Per Burcu's boxel#6045 decision, custom variables belong on a Brand Guide, never on a StructuredTheme.
   - Backdrop materials: `--bx-popover-bg-tint` (the `tint` backdrop fill) · `--bx-popover-bg-blur` (the `blur` backdrop fill — must stay translucent or the backdrop-filter shows nothing) · `--bx-popover-dim-bg` (the page-dim layer behind a `dim` popover)
   - Size tiers: `--bx-popover-size-{compact,comfortable,spacious}-{min-w,max-w,max-h}` in rem — set `min-w` equal to `max-w` for fixed-width popovers (no width jump when `@kind` swaps content)
   - `--bx-popover-bg` and `--bx-popover-border` are the component's own internal variables (set per backdrop / kind / elevation from the theme tokens); do not set them from a theme.
2. **Theme semantic tokens** — `--popover` · `--popover-foreground` · `--card` · `--inset` · `--border` · `--muted-foreground` · `--radius` · `--shadow-{sm,md,xl}` · `--font-sans`. Radius and shadow per elevation tier, the edit pane's `--inset` surface, and every text colour come from here; author a normal theme and the popover follows automatically.
3. **Built-in defaults** — used when neither scope defines a value, so the popover stands alone with no theme at all.

The bundled **Theme/midnight-glass** and **Theme/paper-press** Brand Guides demo both scopes: midnight-glass sets the three backdrop materials on top of a dark contract palette, paper-press the size family (fixed-width 15 / 20 / 26.25 rem tiers so kind swaps never change width) on a paper-and-ink palette. The playground instance links paper-press out of the box — the stage shows a "Themed" chip naming the linked Theme card.

## Companion modules (bundled in this listing)
- **surfacePopoverBinding** (`modifiers/popover-binding`) — element modifier that translates pointer/click gestures on each source unit into `PopoverState` transitions.
- **PopoverState** (`utils/popover-state`) — per-host state machine owning the open `(row, col, kind)` plus hover-pause / dismiss-grace timers.
- **SurfaceLayerManager** (`utils/layer-manager`) — dynamic z-index allocator so nested popovers / lifts / modals stack deterministically.
- **popover-types** (`utils/popover-types`) — the axis unions plus kind→glyph / kind→label maps and the escalation-priority resolver.
